TileStructure.Forest.indicator_adjoint_t.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space and work under the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\times X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$, $F,G\subseteq X$ of `ProofData` (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space with measure $\mu$), together with a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` with set of tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$. Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be an $n$-forest. (Lemma 7.4.2, part 2) Let $u \in t$, and let $g:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support and $\operatorname{supp} g \subseteq G$. Then $$\big\|\mathbf{1}_F \cdot T^*_{\mathfrak{T}(u)} g\big\|_{L^2(\mu)} \le C_{7.3.1.2}(a)\, \mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak{T}(u))^{1/2}\, \mathrm{dens}_2(\mathfrak{T}(u))^{1/2}\, \|g\|_{L^2(\mu)},$$ where $T^*_{\mathfrak{T}(u)}$ is the adjoint Carleson sum over the tree $\mathfrak{T}(u)$ and $C_{7.3.1.2}$ is `Forest.C7_3_1_2`.

Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be an $n$-forest. (Lemma 7.4.3) Let $u \in t$, and let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support and $\operatorname{supp} f \subseteq G$. Then $$\|\text{adjointBoundaryOperator}_t(u, f)\|_{L^2(\mu)} \le C_{7.4.3}(a)\, \|f\|_{L^2(\mu)},$$ where $C_{7.4.3}$ is `Forest.C7_4_3`.

TileStructure.Forest.overlap_implies_dis.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space and work under the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\times X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$, $F,G\subseteq X$ of `ProofData` (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space with measure $\mu$), together with a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` with set of tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$. Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be an $n$-forest. (Lemma 7.4.7, part 1) Let $u_1, u_2 \in t$ with $u_1 \ne u_2$ and $\mathcal{I}(u_1) \le \mathcal{I}(u_2)$, and let $p\in\mathfrak P(X)$. If $p \in \mathfrak{T}(u_1) \cup \mathfrak{T}(u_2)$ and $\mathcal{I}(p)$ is not disjoint from $\mathcal{I}(u_1)$, then $p \in \mathfrak{S}_0(u_1,u_2)$.

TileStructure.Forest.adjoint_density_tre.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space and work under the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\times X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$, $F,G\subseteq X$ of `ProofData` (making $X$ a doubling metric measure space with measure $\mu$), together with a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` with set of tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$. Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and let $t$ be an $n$-forest. Let $u \in t$. Let $f, g:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support, with $\operatorname{supp} f \subseteq F$ and $\operatorname{supp} g \subseteq G$. Then $$\Big|\int_X \overline{T^*_{\mathfrak{T}(u)} g(x)}\, f(x)\,d\mu(x)\Big| \le C_{7.3.1.2}(a)\, \mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak{T}(u))^{1/2}\, \mathrm{dens}_2(\mathfrak{T}(u))^{1/2}\, \|f\|_{L^2(\mu)}\, \|g\|_{L^2(\mu)},$$ where $T^*_{\mathfrak{T}(u)}$ is `adjointCarlesonSum` over $\mathfrak{T}(u)$ and $C_{7.3.1.2}$ is `Forest.C7_3_1_2`.
